title: ALPS: Measuring Valid Creativity in Large Language Models with Mathematical Construction
abstract: arXiv:2608.15979v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models produce outputs presented as discoveries - new proofs, conjectures, or molecules. Whether such an output that appears creative is truly original and effective is hard to establish: open-ended outputs require subjective judgment, the output may replicate something seen in training, or the task may be too simple to need creativity. We present ALPS (Austin-Law Proof-Synthesis), a benchmark that designs a task to measure valid creativity: producing a solution that is original and can be proven correct. Each instance is a single equational law, certified to require either the construction of an infinite mathematical structure satisfying the law, or a proof that no such structure exists. Submissions are verified by automated proof checking with no human involvement, and a public generator produces new instances without limit, so LLMs are never evaluated on problems they may have seen. translated_title: ALPS：通过数学构造衡量大型语言模型中的有效创造力
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.15979v1 公告类型：新 摘要：大型语言模型产生的输出常被呈现为发现——新的证明、猜想或分子。然而，这种看似有创造性的输出是否真正具有原创性和有效性，很难确定：开放式输出需要主观判断，输出可能复现训练中见过的内容，或者任务可能过于简单而不需要创造力。我们提出了ALPS（奥斯汀-劳证明综合）基准，该基准设计了一项任务来衡量有效创造力：生成一个既具有原创性又能被证明正确的解决方案。每个实例都是一个等式定律，经认证要么需要构造一个满足该定律的无限数学结构，要么需要证明不存在这样的结构。提交结果通过自动化证明检查进行验证，无需人工参与，且一个公开生成器可无限产生新实例，因此大型语言模型永远不会在可能见过的题目上被评估。八种配置的组合...
tldr: ALPS基准通过要求模型构造或证明无限数学结构的等式定律，并采用自动化验证和无限新实例生成，实现了对大型语言模型有效创造力的客观衡量。
en_tdlr: The ALPS benchmark objectively measures valid creativity in LLMs by requiring them to construct or disprove infinite mathematical structures for equational laws, with automated verification and unlimited new instance generation.
